content: Service Name V2x M_ Trigger Pseudonym Change Syntax Std_ Return Type V2x M_ Trigger Pseudonym Change ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x08 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: request successful E_ NOT_ OK: request failed Description This function is called by the V2x Fac, V2x Gn or another entity to change the Pseudonym used by the V2X - Stack, e.g. due to a Geo Networking address conflict. Available via V2x M.h
